name: Miracle No-ton Tadaima Zouryou Chuu!!
original_name: みらくるのーとん 只今増量中!!
source:
This is an add on to Miracle No-ton, where Akira magically warps over to the planet of horny notebooks, with 3 new characters.

[from [url=http://sandeian.wordpress.com/2010/05/31/bl-game-review-%E2%80%93-miracle-no-ton-tadaima-zouryou%C2%A0chuu/]4shiki[/url]]
translation:
本作是《Miracle No-ton》的追加内容。明被魔法传送到了情欲笔记所在的星球，并将邂逅三名新角色。

[摘自[url=http://sandeian.wordpress.com/2010/05/31/bl-game-review-%E2%80%93-miracle-no-ton-tadaima-zouryou%C2%A0chuu/]4shiki[/url]]
